messages:
emily nguyen: Heads up — AWS/GCP/Azure storefronts want a final SKU naming + manifest before legal signs off. We missed a small export-control line in the AWS offer docs. Can we triage?

raj patel: I can take the export-control paragraph. Where's the latest manifest?

marco silva: Uploaded `storefront-manifest-v1.4.json` to the partnerships folder and added AMI/VM image ids for AWS/GCP. Link: https://drive.internal/r/redwood/partner-manifests :paperclip:

liz chen: Thanks Marco. Quick Q on SKU format — do we stick with `redwood-core-v{major}.{minor}-{cloud}-{edition}`? Example: `redwood-core-v1.4-aws-enterprise`

emily nguyen: That's the preferred pattern but Legal wants the SKU mapping table to include label and long description columns for marketplace metadata. Also need to confirm trial vs paid SKUs (trial sku suffix `-trial`).

raj patel: OK I'll add the export-control clause and the SKU mapping table into the manifest. Will push a patch later today.

marco silva: When you update, please also add a `compatibility` field for accelerator types (e.g. a100, h100) and quantization profile tag so we can surface supported instances in the storefront.

liz chen: For GCP we need image family names and for Azure the Publisher/Offer/SKU triple. Can we standardize fields to `image_family`, `publisher`, `offer`, `sku_id`?

emily nguyen: Yep — target manifest schema: `sku_id`, `display_name`, `long_description`, `cloud`, `image_family|ami_id|vm_image`, `publisher`, `offer`, `compatibility`, `trial`, `legal_notes`. I'll drop a sample snippet in a minute.

raj patel: Patch pushed: `storefront-manifest-v1.5.json` — includes export-control, SKU table, and legal_notes placeholder. Please review. PR: https://git.internal/rw/partnerships/manifest/pull/87

liz chen: Reviewing now. Noting one gap: localization tags (en-US, fr-FR) — marketplace requires localized descriptions.

emily nguyen: Good catch. Add `locales` map with keys for `display_name` and `long_description`. Example: ```"locales": {"en-US": {"display_name": "Redwood Inference Core", "long_description": "High-throughput LLM inference..."}, "fr-FR": {...}}```

legal-bot: @emily_nguyen Please ensure `legal_notes` contains export control classification and a reference to the customer data handling section. Missing sections will delay publishing.

emily nguyen: Will update with legal text and locale entries by EOD. Action items: 1) Raj — confirm legal paragraph (in PR). 2) Marco — add accelerator compatibility tags. 3) Liz — add publisher/offer triples for Azure + image_family for GCP. 4) Emily — finalize locales + submit to Legal for final sign-off.

liz chen: Sounds good. If Legal signs off tomorrow we can schedule the marketplace submission for next Tue. :calendar:

raj patel: Done — updated PR with legal paragraph and linked internal export-control reference: https://legal.internal/export-control/rw-2026.

marco silva: Added `compatibility` entries and sample quantization tags. Pushed to the same PR.

emily nguyen: Thanks everyone — I'll run a final sweep and ping @legal-bot after I add locales. If nothing else, we'll plan submissions per-cloud on Tue.

liz chen: Ping me when it's final, I'll coordinate the publisher portal uploads and trial entitlements. :thumbsup:
